PZZ700-112215-
230 AM PDT Sun Oct 11 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...At 2 AM, a 1028 mb high
was about 995 nautical miles west of Eureka California. Post 
Tropical Cyclone Rachel has moved inland over southern California.
The remnants of Rachel will bring an increase in southerly swell 
leading to choppy, combined seas up to 11 feet through this 
evening, along with strong and gusty north northwest winds up to 
25 knots turning westerly through the afternoon. Winds and seas 
subside through Monday. More typical onshore flow returns by 
Tuesday.

$$
